verdict.rationale: PayPal maintains a dedicated OpenAPI specifications repo (paypal-rest-api-specifications) with machine-readable JSON specs (e.g., checkout_orders_v2.json) used for codegen, and also exposes llms.txt/markdown docs for AI consumption. This confirms downloadable, machine-readable API specs exist and are officially maintained. Missing for 10: no direct link/citation to a canonical hosted OpenAPI spec download page or independent confirmation of completeness across all API products.
